presets.name: Muted text
presets.description: Small grey text for notes, footnotes and footers

resources.name: Epistola Logo
resources.description: Small brand logo for use in templates.

resources.name: Epistola Catalog Preview
resources.description: Preview illustration for the demo catalog gallery.

resources.name: Language
resources.description: Document language for multi-language template variants.

resources.name: Corporate Theme
resources.description: A clean corporate theme with professional styling.

resources.name: Company Header
resources.description: Reusable company header block with logo placeholder and company name.

resources.name: Letter Shell
resources.description: A letter shell built from the Letterhead stencil, with a body that templates fill. Its company name reaches the letterhead and, through the body placeholder, the template's fill.

resources.name: Letterhead
resources.description: A page header and footer that travel with the stencil: its header applies from where it is placed, its footer covers that section.

resources.name: Customer Address
resources.description: An address block that reads the using template's data (customer.name, customer.street, customer.postalCode, customer.city) instead of taking parameters.

resources.name: Hello World
resources.description: A minimal template to get started. Contains a heading and a paragraph with data binding.

resources.name: Advanced Data Contract
resources.description: A focused test template for editing local references, schema compositions, nullable unions, mixed object variants, deeply nested arrays, and nested-loop expression scopes.

resources.name: Quality Showcase
resources.description: Deliberately flawed: an empty block, an overlong one, and an image with no alt text, so the quality report and editor panel have real findings to show. Enable the alpha 'quality' feature to see them.

resources.name: Simple Letter
resources.description: A basic letter template with sender, recipient, subject, and body.

resources.name: Invoice Template
resources.description: Professional invoice with line items, tax calculation, QR payment code, and conditional notes. Demonstrates datatables, columns, tables, conditionals, expressions, and the cover-page + running pageheader pattern.

resources.name: Verkeersboete
resources.description: Dutch traffic-fine notice (CJIB-style). Showcases locale-aware date and number formatting via $formatDate (four distinct patterns — long-form, short, date+time, no-leading-zero) and $formatLocaleNumber (integer speeds and currency amounts). Three variants exercise the locale chain: default (inherits from tenant/app), nl-NL (Dutch month names, '1.234,56' grouping), en-US (English month names, '1,234.56' grouping).

resources.name: Sectioned Letter
resources.description: A cover, a letter and terms, each with its own page header and footer. Demonstrates headers and footers placed anywhere: a conditional cover header, a letterhead stencil, a section-start header after a page break, a header switching mid-section, footers that apply from the page they land on, and an empty footer that switches the band off.

resources.name: Batch Letters
resources.description: One letter per recipient in a single document: a loop repeats a page header, footer and page break, so each letter gets its own header and footer with that recipient's data.

resources.name: Stencil Showcase
resources.description: A letter built from stencils: a shell that contains the letterhead stencil, a body fill reading the parameters the shell passes, and an address stencil that reads the template's data.
